scene.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; an indoor surf-wave practice pool with turquoise water — she takes a cheerful break from balancing practice; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — standing close to a high shelf or line; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a bright glass-roofed intercity tram moving through a coastal city — she balances a small paper bag of freshly roasted chestnuts on her lap; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — dries her hair with a towel; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — standing; the rail of a harbour ferry deck in the wind — standing with one foot up on a step; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — standing

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her Three Kingdoms identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
